summary: Extensible developer launcher on macOS and Windows — developer love, native speed, and 1,500+ extension ecosystem create a deep moat.
moat: Raycast's moat is native OS speed, keyboard-first workflow integration, and a thriving developer community that has published over 1,500 open-source extensions connecting GitHub, Linear, Jira, and Spotify. Raycast Pro's native AI integration allows developers to use Claude, GPT-4, and custom AI commands without context-switching away from their active window, turning AI from a competitor into an engagement driver.

challengers.name: Alfred, Spotlight AI, and browser-native command palettes
challengers.evidence: Apple's Apple Intelligence integration directly inside macOS Spotlight brings local AI queries to all Mac users out of the box, reducing the need for third-party launchers for mainstream consumers.
